phases: P0
Definition, data and target

Register information, definition, model and policy trials with budgets, primary metrics and confirmatory rules before outcomes. Binding local contract SR-V03: Register the search over definitions, inputs, labels, models, gates and policies together. Keep scientifically screened-out, failed-to-run, data-blocked and empirically rejected branches distinct; an early screening gate cannot silently erase mandatory scope. Binding substantive upgrade UP-V03: Separate a registered broad family pilot from bounded expansion and preserve all attempted definitions, hypotheses and stopping decisions. Register exact added targets/ports and applicable UPGRADE_CONSTRUCTIONS before dependent code; retain every source variant and the earlier improvement path. Target: Reproducible selected version and uncertainty accounting. Confirm the exact inputs, observation clock, units, coverage and model capabilities in the linked parent contract and this local definition. Freeze definition/variant/horizon and baseline before outcomes.
Complete numeric/data/target manifest; unsupported inputs remain gated. This is a planned implementation check.
P1
Reference, causality and faults

Local mandatory cases: Renamed duplicate, unlogged failure, outer-test threshold change and omitted earlier attempts. Verify this child against the applicable SR-V03 contract cases; reference shared parent evidence and add child integration assertions rather than repeating unrelated cases. Specific upgrade cases: Successful window chosen from many; abandoned failed model omitted; expensive family crowds out others. Add suffix-deletion, delayed/corrected-input and restart equivalence through this unit and its consumers.
Named assertions with expected outcomes for every listed case; zero unexplained semantic/causal failures, bounded declared ambiguity and numerical tolerance.
P2
Isolated quality and challengers

Compare: Small frozen grid; equal-budget random search; justified larger search as new trial family. Specific further-upgrade comparison: Compare information versus representation/capacity under matched budgets, retaining negative/inconclusive branches and held-out integrity. Primary local evidence: Complete trial ledger, nested selection and fixed-endpoint confirmation.

Exact services require reference/invariance consistency; any learned comparison uses the same target/horizon/cohort, separates information from model class, fits/tunes only inside the chronology, and reports effect intervals/learning curves.
P3
Calibration, support and generalization

Exact facts get fidelity/coverage/numerical-error reports, not learned confidence. Any downstream learned head, fitted transform or uncertainty model requires chronological OOF/calibration; report year/session/age/coverage sensitivity and effective observations.
No in-sample substitution at learned edges; report unsupported/rare cohorts rather than unconditional confidence. Deterministic correctness is not an alpha claim.
P4
Increment and interactions

Ablations/controls: Search budget, selection method and information/model capacity separated. Preserve source-faithful computable, corrected/earlier-upgraded and further-candidate stages. Separate added information, representation and learner capacity; apply the local geometry, latency, uncertainty and resource controls. No representative-only substitution for the other child/source variants. Also register no-component/simple-component and selected 2x2 interactions where applicable. Hard position/account/integrity constraints stay in every eligible policy comparison; relaxations are separate diagnostics.
Held-out increment under a frozen useful-effect/non-inferiority rule, or a prespecified joint interaction/invariant role; trial/search accounting complete.
P5
Decision consequences

Use: Defines best supported among tested alternatives without claiming a global optimum. Compare the explicit reference/negative/positive controls and intended evidence decisions. A governance service earns acceptance through valid inference, reconciliation or bounded operational behavior, not invented alpha.
Attribution reconciles with a full rerun; include rejected, untraded, no-touch and non-fill opportunities. Local score alone is insufficient for policy promotion.
P6
Integrated economic confirmation

Run the appropriate E0–E5 complete one-account/one-mini policy with independently reserved daily/account risk, actual required cutoff, all-in fees, latency/fill stress and all eligible days. Select before frozen outer/future confirmation.
Report paired daily net/risk/occupancy, account survival, uncertainty and objective gap. A useful component need not meet $2,000/day alone; the complete policy must be evaluated against that target.
P7
Future parity, monitoring and fallback

Freeze parameter policy, future endpoint/inference, input/definition/model versions and monitored local metrics (Complete trial ledger, nested selection and fixed-endpoint confirmation.). Test fallback, stale state, restart and rollback. Detailed R work waits for E5; unavailable data dependencies stay disabled.
Actual captured-receipt/replay and operational evidence when authorized; no future-test tuning. Mark supported/not met/inconclusive with scope. All trading-system phases remain planned here.

Ablations/controls: Candidate set, timing, occupancy, cost and risk one at a time. Preserve source-faithful computable, corrected/earlier-upgraded and further-candidate stages. Decision consequences

Use: Diagnoses a bottleneck without presenting foresight or an unproven ceiling as attainable alpha. Compare the explicit reference/negative/positive controls and intended evidence decisions. A governance service earns acceptance through valid inference, reconciliation or bounded operational behavior, not invented alpha.
Attribution reconciles with a full rerun; include rejected, untraded, no-touch and non-fill opportunities. Local score alone is insufficient for policy promotion.
P6
Integrated economic confirmation

Run the appropriate E0–E5 complete one-account/one-mini policy with independently reserved daily/account risk, actual required cutoff, all-in fees, latency/fill stress and all eligible days. Select before frozen outer/future confirmation.
Report paired daily net/risk/occupancy, account survival, uncertainty and objective gap. A useful component need not meet $2,000/day alone; the complete policy must be evaluated against that target.
P7
Future parity, monitoring and fallback

Freeze parameter policy, future endpoint/inference, input/definition/model versions and monitored local metrics (Exact state/reward reconciliation and explicitly scoped bound inequalities.). Test fallback, stale state, restart and rollback. Detailed R work waits for E5; unavailable data dependencies stay disabled.
